title: A Mod About PWGood (Chapter 1)
description: A mod about russian streamer PWGood.
body:
**ONLY FOR THE SINGLE PLAYER!**
# A Mod About PWGood
A great story mod about the Russian PWGood streamer. In this mod, you will be greeted by new mobs, blocks, and items. Some vanilla crafts have been simplified. Unravel PWGoood's plans and try to stop him
